method: Read-only AWS CLI EC2 and CloudFormation inventory; identifiers, account metadata, IPs, and tag values intentionally excluded.
conclusion: No existing EC2 host is proven to be owned by an active CloudFormation stack; do not credit this inventory as available or reusable launch capacity.
limitations: Only CloudFormation ownership was queried; Terraform or other IaC state and out-of-band ownership were not inspected.
This is a point-in-time inventory, not permission to reuse, mutate, or incur spend on any resource.
